about.title: About Me
about.p1: Full stack developer. I work with React, Node and MongoDB, and with Python whenever something repetitive needs automating.
about.p2: I built Atalaya, a command line tool that pulls dev job listings from eight boards and scores them against your profile, with 147 tests and mypy in strict mode. And SaveMyMoneyNow, which turns statements from four different banks, each with its own format, into a spending dashboard with rule based categorisation.

projects.title: WordPress automation in production
projects.description: Python and Bash tooling to operate WordPress sites in production: audits, post deploy verification and migrations between providers. What used to be done site by site now runs in a single pass.

projects.title: SaveMyMoneyNow
projects.description: Turns bank statements, which every bank exports its own way, into a spending dashboard. An assistant detects the header row and maps the columns, then rules categorise movements and drop duplicates. 21 endpoints and 66 test cases.

projects.title: Atalaya
projects.description: Python CLI that pulls remote dev listings from eight job boards, scores them against your profile and drafts the cover letter with Claude. 147 passing tests and mypy in strict mode.

projects.title: Strev
projects.description: Private beta MERN fitness SaaS: 115 endpoints across 26 modules, with cookie auth, payments, gamification and routines generated with Claude. 133 test files.
